d: We are looking for a creative, proactive, and hands-on Senior Marketing Executive to manage and execute marketing activities across a portfolio of F&B brands. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in restaurant or F&B marketing, with experience managing multiple brands, developing marketing campaigns, coordinating creative content, and executing brand activations.

This role requires someone who is well-connected with Kuwait's F&B market, understands consumer and social media trends, and enjoys being actively involved in restaurant visits, photoshoots, launches, and marketing events.
q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
4–6+ years of relevant marketing experience, preferably within the restaurant, F&B, or hospitality industry.
Proven experience managing marketing campaigns, multiple brands, or simultaneous marketing projects.
Strong understanding of restaurant marketing, social media trends, and consumer behavior in Kuwait and the GCC.
Experience coordinating with designers, content creators, photographers, agencies, and other creative partners.
Good understanding of brand positioning, creative content, influencer marketing, and promotional activities.
Strong organizational, project management, and execution skills.
Fluency in Arabic and English is required.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.
Willingness to attend restaurant visits, photoshoots, events, and brand activations as required.
Familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Meta Ads, or digital campaign reporting would be an advantage.
r: Plan, coordinate, and execute marketing campaigns across multiple F&B brands, ensuring consistency with each brand's identity and positioning.
Develop and maintain monthly and annual marketing calendars, including promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and events.
Oversee social media content planning and execution across Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
Coordinate with graphic designers, social media teams, photographers, videographers, and external creative agencies.
Develop creative briefs and oversee the production of marketing materials, digital content, menus, packaging, and promotional assets.
Identify and coordinate influencer collaborations, brand partnerships, restaurant activations, and promotional events.
Work closely with restaurant operations and culinary teams to support new menu launches, promotional activities, and restaurant openings.
Conduct regular restaurant visits to ensure marketing campaigns and promotional materials are implemented effectively.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer preferences to identify new marketing opportunities.
Track campaign performance, social media engagement, and key marketing metrics, providing reports and recommendations to management.
Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines while ensuring timely execution and brand consistency.

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
